items.text: kal kar dena
shaam ko theek hai
subah tak chahiye tha
haan ji please
nahi abhi nahi
teen baje kar do
kal shaam ko kar do

items.context: Kya aap delivery ko reschedule karna chahenge?
items.text: haan karein
do din baad theek rahega
main delivery kal savere karna chahta hoon
mera address change ho gaya hai kya kar sakte ho
kya aap delivery time ko badal sakte hain
main apni delivery ko agle hafte tak postpone karna chahta hoon
shayad delivery aaj der se aayegi kya kar sakte hain
mera phone number bhi update karna hai delivery mein
main apne parcel ko jald se jald lena chahta hoon please help
kya main delivery ko kal dopahar kar sakta hoon

items.context: Kya aap delivery date mein badlav chahenge?
items.text: mera order galat din bhej diya tha kya karenge

items.context: Delivery ke liye naya din kya hoga?
items.text: agar main apni delivery agle somvaar karwa doon to possible hai

items.context: Kya aap delivery address update karna chahenge?
items.text: delivery address bhi badalwana hai mera naya address bata doon

items.context: Kya aap delivery ko reschedule karke jaldi lena chahte hain?
items.text: main apne order ko jaldi chahata hoon to kya ho sakta hai
mera jo order tha usko main do din baad accept karna chahta hoon kyunki ghar par tabhi main available rahunga
aapka delivery staff mera order kal dopehar tak nahi le aaya tha isliye main usko agle hafte bhejna chahta hoon
main apni delivery ko subah ke 10 baje ki jagah shaam ke 6 baje shift karna chahata hoon kya aap kar sakte hain
merko mera parcel fast lena hai lekin mera schedule change ho gaya hai to main delivery ko badalna chahta hoon
kal mera number 9988776655 pe contact karna tha lekin main available nahi tha toh delivery ab kab kar sakte hain
mera order pehle 15 march ko tha ab main usko 18 march ko chahata hoon agar possible ho to mujhe batayein
mainne apne address mein thodi der pehle parivartan kiya tha aap please delivery ko wahan shift kar dein
delivery ka jo samay fix tha usse main badal kar dopahar 3 baje ka karna chahta hoon kyunki subah ghar par nahi milunga
agar main apni delivery ko agle hafte ke bajaye is hafte fast receive karna chahta hoon toh kya kar sakte hain
mera order number 4 2 8 0 1 hai aur main apni delivery kal ki jagah parso karna chahta hoon

items.context: Aapki delivery kab kar na chahenge?
items.text: main delivery ko kab receive karna chahunga is par apka kya sujhav hai

items.context: Aap delivery ke liye nayi date kya rakhna chaheinge?
items.text: mera order 7 march ko aana tha par main use 9 march ko lena chahta hoon

items.context: Aap delivery timing ko badalna chahenge na?
items.text: kya mujhe apna parcel kal ki jagah agle din mil sakta hai kyonki main kal busy rahunga

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: reschedule - wants the delivery on a different day or time
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
